content:
Generates a single-use linking key that is valid for two hours. Additionally, the target site for your
account is retrieved (ex. us-2b ).
The linking key and target site are required when creating an OT connector with the Create OT
connector endpoint.
Once linked, an OT connector can transmit assets and findings data from Tenable OT Security to
Tenable Vulnerability Management.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
Default: "ot"
Value: "ot"
The type of connector or sensor. This value is always ot  for OT
connectors.
type
required
